name: Carrot
life: Usually biennial; grown for its root
intro: Carrots are grown for swollen roots. Cultivars can be orange, purple, white or yellow.
observe: The root develops mainly underground. The green leaves are separate from the orange harvest.
habitat: Needs loose, well-drained soil and sun. Stones or compacted soil can cause misshapen roots.
fact: RHS gives about 12–16 weeks as a common harvest guide; baby carrots can be picked earlier.
